why: The comments form a forest given as a flat parent list. Group children under their parent in input order, then a preorder DFS from each root (in input order) emits each comment indented by its depth.
hints: A child can appear before its parent, so first build the whole structure, then render.
Map each id to the list of its children's indices, appending in input order; roots are those with parent -1, also in input order.
Iterative DFS with a stack of (index, depth), pushing children in reverse so the first child pops first; output '  ' * depth + text. O(n).
pitfalls: Indent is exactly two spaces per level.
Sibling order is input order, not id order.
Deep threads (10^5 levels) overflow recursion; use a stack.
